title: AI Agents & Knowledge Systems
description: Techlio builds AI agents and RAG knowledge systems grounded in your data, with citations, guardrails, evals and full audit trails.
h1: Agents that cite their sources and stay inside their permissions.
intro: We build assistants and agents that answer from your documents, databases and tickets, take action through permissioned tools, and hand off to a person when the evidence is thin.
caption: A question passes an access check, searches company sources, is composed and cited, then checked for grounding before it is delivered or handed off.
offerIntro: Four stages, in order. The eval set from stage one is what every later change is measured against.

offerings.title: Map the knowledge
offerings.text: We inventory your sources, their owners and their permissions, and collect real questions with known good answers as the first eval set.

offerings.title: Design the system
offerings.text: Retrieval strategy, model selection, tools the agent may call, and the guardrails and thresholds around each action.

offerings.title: Build and evaluate
offerings.text: The agent is built against the eval set. Retrieval quality, answer grounding and tool use are each scored separately.

offerings.title: Deploy with guardrails
offerings.text: Rollout to a small group first, with human review on low-confidence answers and a trace stored for every decision.

whyTitle: Why these agents survive contact with real users

why.title: Evals over guesswork
why.text: Every prompt, model or retrieval change is scored on your own cases before release. A regression fails the build.

why.title: Guardrails by default
why.text: Permission checks, injection screening and human review on high-impact actions ship with the first version.

why.title: Answers that act
why.text: Agents work through typed, permissioned tools, so they can update a record or open a ticket without free rein over your systems.

closeTitle: What should your team be able to ask, and have done?
closeText: Bring the questions and tasks you have in mind. We will show you what a grounded, auditable agent for them would involve.

card.lead: Agents that act, with answers you can audit.
card.text: Assistants and agents grounded in your own data, with citations, guardrails and a full trace behind every action they take.
